summary: Work Order (Mobile View) – Unable to add new line in phone view
reported_issue: In phone view, users cannot add a new line to a work order - the 'Add New Line' option does not appear, and Line/Part/Notes/Stat/Finance are not visible.
expected_after_fix: In phone view users can see and select an 'Add New Line' option and the Lines/Parts/Notes/Stats/Finance tabs.
steps_i_followed: Launched a Chromium mobile context (390x844, iPhone UA, isMobile+touch) authenticated as admin.
Opened a Work Order's Lines tab (/workorders/{id}/lines) in the phone viewport.
Checked for the New Line button and for the Lines/Parts/Notes/Stats/Finance tabs, and confirmed visibility.
actual_now: In the phone viewport the New Line button (data-test-id=button_new_line) is present and visible (offsetParent not null), and all tabs render: Lines (4), Parts (5), Notes, Timesheets, History, Stats, Finance. Users can see the Add New Line control and the full tab set in mobile view.
notes: Emulated an iPhone-sized viewport with touch. The reported missing controls (Add New Line, Line/Part/Notes/Stat/Finance) are all present and visible now.
